BiblicalUsage: Arpad is a city of Syria, named when empires boast and when prophets judge. Rabshakeh asks where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad, Assyria says Is not Samaria as Damascus and Arpad as Hamath, and Jeremiah says Damascus is confounded, and Arpad with it, for they have heard evil tidings.
TheologicalSignificance: A city named three times for its gods and its fall tells me that no city's gods can save it, and that the empires which boast over one city will boast over the next until God stops them.
